title: rose smoke plays the half-time backbeat; guitar and choir carry the break
story: Please Do Not Lean feels at 64 BPM (onset lag 30 ticks; the report's 129 BPM is the eighth grid): kick on 1 and 3 (dark, centroid <0.16), snare on 2 and 4 (bright, ~0.27), hats on the off-beat eighths. Each drum has its own carrier: every kick floods the rose smoke (corte down), lifts it and pushes in; every snare flashes the side light with contrast and a short shake; every hat flushes saturation and sharpens the edges; the light and hue step every two beats. After the fill (3842/3857/3871) the drums drop out and the smoke thins to lavender, but it keeps following the music: each guitar note swings the side light to an angle set by its pitch with a contrast flick, and each choir swell thickens the smoke with a warm rose glow. At 4342 the snare comes back and the drum carriers take over again.
